name: RC-B10-0545/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the EU position on the proposed plan and EU engagement towards a just and lasting peace for Ukraine
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its position on peace for Ukraine. It says any peace deal must respect Ukraine's borders and independence, and must not be decided without Ukraine or Europe. It wants strong security guarantees for Ukraine, full compensation and accountability for Russia, and no lifting of sanctions before a peace deal is agreed and carried out. It also calls for a loan to Ukraine backed by frozen Russian assets. This is an opinion; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; Parliament states its demands and calls for a loan backed by frozen Russian assets.
- **Who it affects:** Ukraine, Russia, EU governments, and the United States.
- **What happens next:** EU governments decide whether to act; sanctions stay until a peace deal is agreed and carried out.
